meta.source: Transportation Tomorrow Survey (Data Management Group, University of Toronto)
meta.note: Trips by primary mode, household ward and straight-line trip length, plus school trips by age of person (a separate cross-tab, with no trip length). Wards use the current 25-ward model; 2001–2016 counts are apportioned from the former 44-ward model by area-weighted crosswalk. "Commute" = home-based work or school trips; work and school are the same trips split by purpose.
